reason: We have always washed by hand at home and it works fine, so I don't see why I should spend twenty-two thousand on a machine, even a clever one. The money can go to the pump or the shop first.
objection: Who will repair it in my village when the battery or motor fails after two years, and how much will a new battery cost? The dealer is in town, not here.
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour I trust had one running for a year without trouble, and the dealer wrote down the replacement battery price and promised to come to the village for repairs.
